card: Adds explicit test spenders for five legacy script edge cases to feature_taproot.py, covering OP_CHECKSEQUENCEVERIFY with negative operands, 5-byte numeric operands, OP_IFDUP on negative/non-minimal zero, OP_ROLL with duplicate stack elements, and OP_16 in P2SH scriptSig. These target edge conditions that led to bugs in alternative implementations such as bitcoin-s but were discarded by coverage-based test minimizers. Merging this enables exporting these test dumps into qa-assets (bitcoin-core/qa-assets#297).
changed_since_previous: Diff provided; confirms the implementation adds the five legacy script spender edge cases to feature_taproot.py.
evidence: PR description: 'These were discovered by finding gaps in an alternate implementation (bitcoin-s)'

PR description and commit: 'Each case hits an already-covered branch, so the minimizer drops it, and none are caught by the current vectors. Naming them lets their dumps be added to the script assets.'
problem: Existing functional test vectors do not explicitly exercise these edge cases, and automated test-minimizers discard them because adjacent tests already reach the underlying code branches. As a result, dumped test vectors lack cases that have tripped up alternative Bitcoin implementations.

risk.why: It only adds test cases to an existing Python functional test suite.

summary: Adds explicit test spenders for legacy script edge cases to the feature_taproot functional test. The new test cases exercise OP_CHECKSEQUENCEVERIFY with negative operands, 5-byte operands whose values fit in fewer bytes, OP_IFDUP with negative or non-minimal zero, OP_ROLL with identical stack values, and OP_16 in a P2SH scriptSig.
